reply_text:
I replied to Dana in your direct messages. I confirmed that from now on, their cutoff for the Brackenwater Freight Co. paperwork on the Juniper renewal is 26 September. I also said I wouldn't share it in other conversations.

I asked them to double-check the date: it's already 14 October, so 26 September has passed this year. They may have meant another date, or 26 September next year.

There's no separate memory store among my tools. The only record of this is that direct message, so the cutoff is "remembered" only as long as that message can be read later.
